answer_1.quote: Our goal in this paper is to explore methods to train language models to improve the summary quality with HF inexpensively.

answer_2.quote: Models are evaluated with full-length F1-scores of ROUGE. We use QuickUMLS to extract medical concepts from both model-generated and ground truth summaries and then calculate F1-scores for these two lists of concepts, which is named UMLS-F1.

answer_3.quote: Specifically, we instruct GPT4 to give preference ranking on different AI-generated summaries based on the conversation snippet and reference summary.

answer_4.quote: Similarly, we asked 2 medical students to rate summaries from CC based on the same information, for privacy reasons, we did not evaluate CCUser with humans.
answer_4.guideline: Preference ranking based on conversation snippet and reference summary
